page_note: Extremely pure substrate page. After the opening dialogue attribution at seg 0, the entire page is cosmological-correspondential exposition mapping cosmic structures: the great garments / five noeric ones / Pillar of Glory / Perfect Man / Ambassador / Jesus the Splendor / archons of firmaments / stars / Aromos / Omophoros / three lands / great garments-of-laklek / Living Power / five worlds of flesh / Living Spirit on the three garments (wind/fire/water) / Omophoros / Elements / Cross of Light / Power of Light. All mappings stay cosmos→cosmos. Editorial fatigue score is negative (-3.12), confirming that the second half is even purer than the first — apostolic_dialogue vocabulary collapses to 0 after seg 0. The "we have named" / "they have given names" formulae are part of the substrate's own metalinguistic vocabulary about cosmic naming, not editorial framing.
